layers.name: Urban fabric / tissue
layers.definition: Coherent region of street–plot–building relations (Conzen plan unit; Caniggia tissue; Urban Taxonomy fabric clusters).

layers.name: Transect zone
layers.definition: Rural-to-urban intensity band (T1–T6) that selects appropriate street, frontage, and building character.

layers.name: Street / thoroughfare
layers.definition: Public way that structures blocks and fronts plots. Hierarchy by mobility vs access (arterial → local → lane).

layers.name: Street block
layers.definition: Island of plots bounded by the street pattern; the unit of neighborhood grain.

layers.name: Plot / parcel
layers.definition: Cadastral cell that contains buildings and private open space; Conzen’s plot series faces a street.

layers.name: Building morphology
layers.definition: Massing relation to the block: edge, infill, entire-block, solitary, slab — distinct from program (school, shop).

layers.name: Open space
layers.definition: Public or private outdoor void: street void, court, green finger, playground, fringe.

layers.name: Program / use
layers.definition: What the place does (living, shop, school, civic). Orthogonal to morphological type.

types.name: Coherent dense fabric
types.definition: Street-defined blocks with connected network; buildings adjacent or short-setback (row / urban villa). Typical walkable neighborhood tissue.

types.name: Coherent interconnected fabric
types.definition: High built-up density and short streets; buildings enclose courtyards; narrow distance between blocks.

types.name: Incoherent large-scale fabric
types.definition: Large buildings and utilitarian streets; open space between slabs; modernist / industrial grain.

types.name: T3 Sub-urban
types.definition: Neighborhood edge: lower intensity, houses with yards, limited mix; walkable but more auto-tolerant than T4–T6.

types.name: T4 General urban
types.definition: Mixed houses and shops; medium density; street frontages and courts; seed-neighborhood default.

types.name: T5 Urban center
types.definition: Higher intensity mixed use; shops at street; civic nodes; tighter building line.

types.name: Arterial / boulevard
types.definition: Primary capacity thoroughfare; structures districts. Transect: boulevard. Network hierarchy: arterial.

types.name: Local street
types.definition: Access-oriented walkable street fronting plots; default neighborhood street. Transect: street.

types.name: Lane / alley
types.definition: Narrow low-speed access; mid-block or service. Network hierarchy: lane.

types.name: Country road
types.definition: Rural / fringe thoroughfare meeting the city edge; pairs with country fingers.

types.name: Carriageway
types.definition: Driving surface within a ROW (CityGML TrafficArea).

types.name: Sidewalk
types.definition: Pedestrian clear way within the ROW.

types.name: Perimeter block
types.definition: Plots and buildings along the street edge enclose a private or semi-private interior (court / yard).

types.name: Open block
types.definition: Street-bounded cell with freer building placement; less continuous street wall.

types.name: Frontage plot
types.definition: Parcel in a plot series facing a street with court or setback and address on the network.

types.name: Corner plot
types.definition: Parcel at a street junction; two frontages; often shop or civic.

types.name: Block-edge building
types.definition: Massing that defines the street wall of a block; primary morphological type for frontage lots.

types.name: Block-infill building
types.definition: Massing that occupies a remaining gap in an established street wall.

types.name: Solitary building
types.definition: Freestanding mass in open space; weak street wall (civic campus, villa, utility).

types.name: Slab
types.definition: Elongated multi-unit mass often set in open green; incoherent large-scale fabric.

types.name: Front court
types.definition: Positive outdoor space between street gate and building; transition and south-facing outdoors.

types.name: Country finger / green finger
types.definition: Continuous green corridor penetrating the city (3 City Country Fingers).

types.name: Playground
types.definition: Connected play open space near dwellings and schools.

types.name: Country fringe
types.definition: Countryside belt meeting the metro edge along a country road.

types.name: Living
types.definition: Dwelling program on a frontage or upper storey.

types.name: Shop
types.definition: Individually owned shop / storefront on a shopping street.

types.name: Corner grocery
types.definition: Local food shop on a corner or short walk from dwellings.

types.name: Market
types.definition: Market of many shops / stall cluster at an activity node.

types.name: Shopfront school
types.definition: School as a neighborhood civic massing, not a remote campus.

types.name: Civic / town hall
types.definition: Local government or civic node (town hall, police, related services).

types.name: Health center
types.definition: Neighborhood health / clinic massing.

types.name: Utility / industrial edge
types.definition: Service yard or industrial ribbon at the metro edge.

components.name: Frontage lot kit
components.definition: Stampable plot series cell: lot, pad, front court, optional garden walls/gate, massing, address.

components.name: Program place kit
components.definition: School, shop, park, civic, utility parcel + optional massing.

components.name: City fabric composer
components.definition: Multi-block quarter: streets, continuous fingers, program cells, frontage stamps.

components.name: Street section kit
components.definition: ROW = carriageway + sidewalks + optional median; emits street place + TrafficAreas + network edge.

components.name: Block face kit
components.definition: One street face of a perimeter block: ordered frontage lots + rhythm measure.

components.name: Corner shop kit
components.definition: Corner plot with shop massing and two frontages.
